Intel: detect multiple Python imports

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    pass
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure);
    println!("{:?}", result.imports);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.total_lines);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
}
```
